The Fairfax Virginia-based  company is expected to report a 28.5% increase in revenue to $20.61 million from $16.03 million a year ago, according to the estimate from one analyst, based on LSEG data.
​LSEG's mean analyst estimate for FVCBankcorp Inc is for earnings of 38 cents per share.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy," 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell."
The mean earnings estimate of analysts was unchanged in the last three months. ​
